result.instructions: Tools for Granatum, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bills are due this week, and which are still unpaid?"; "Show me the cash flow report for last quarter."; "List the income transactions for customer Acme in October.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Granatum data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run granatum_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run granatum_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run granatum_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. granatum_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: granatum_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: List the company's bank accounts with their balances (saldo). Good first call to get account ids for other tools. Granatum API: GET /v1/contas.

tools.name: granatum_get_bank_account
tools.title: Get a bank account
tools.description: Get one bank account by id. Granatum API: GET /v1/contas/{id}.

tools.name: granatum_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List income and expense transactions (lançamentos) with filters. Send date_from and date_to together. Use type P (to pay), R (to receive), LP (paid), LR (received), PA/RA (overdue). Granatum API: GET /v1/lancamentos.

account_id.description: Bank account id. Send one of account_id, person_id or classification_id.

type.description: P pay, R receive, LP paid, LR received, PA overdue pay, RA overdue receive, DT no transfers, ST transfers only.

basis.description: Date basis: caixa (cash, default) or competencia (accrual).

search.description: Approximate search in value, description, note and customer or supplier name.

modified_after.description: Only items created or changed after this date (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

view.description: list (id and description), count, or detail (full rows with names, for reporting).

offset.description: Records to skip, for pagination (e.g. 50 for the second page of 50).

tools.name: granatum_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction (lançamento) by id, with its amount, dates, category and payment status. Granatum API: GET /v1/lancamentos/{id}.

tools.name: granatum_list_charges
tools.title: List charges
tools.description: List customer charges (cobranças) created with Granatum Pagamentos, by account, customer, due date or status. Granatum API: GET /v1/cobrancas.

offset.description: Records to skip, for pagination (e.g. 50 for the second page of 50).

tools.name: granatum_get_charge
tools.title: Get a charge
tools.description: Get one customer charge (cobrança) by id, with its status and amount. Granatum API: GET /v1/cobrancas/{id}.

tools.name: granatum_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List income and expense categories. Set children_only to get only the leaf categories of the hierarchy. Granatum API: GET /v1/categorias.

tools.name: granatum_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (clientes), with optional search by name, e-mail, address or phone. Granatum API: GET /v1/clientes.

search.description: Approximate search in company name, e-mail, address and phone.

document.description: Tax id (CNPJ or CPF) without punctuation.

external_id.description: Id of the customer in another system.

tools.name: granatum_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (fornecedores), with optional search by name, e-mail, address or phone. Granatum API: GET /v1/fornecedores.

search.description: Approximate search in company name, e-mail, address and phone.

document.description: Tax id (CNPJ or CPF) without punctuation.

tools.name: granatum_list_cost_centers
tools.title: List cost centers
tools.description: List cost and profit centers (centros de custo e lucro). Granatum API: GET /v1/centros_custo_lucro.

tools.name: granatum_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List payment methods (formas de pagamento). Granatum API: GET /v1/formas_pagamento.

tools.name: granatum_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the company's tags. Granatum API: GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: granatum_cash_flow_report
tools.title: Cash flow report
tools.description: Cash flow report (fluxo de caixa) for a date range. Granatum API: GET /v1/relatorios/fluxo_caixa.

basis.description: Date basis: caixa (cash, default) or competencia (accrual).

tools.name: granatum_profit_loss_report
tools.title: Profit and loss report
tools.description: Profit and loss report (DRE) for a date range. Granatum API: GET /v1/relatorios/dre.

basis.description: Date basis: caixa (cash, default) or competencia (accrual).

tools.name: granatum_create_transaction
tools.title: Create a transaction
tools.description: Create an income or expense transaction (lançamento). A negative amount is an expense, a positive amount is income. This writes financial data: it is not undone by a second call. Granatum API: POST /v1/lancamentos.

amount.description: Amount with decimals. Negative for expense, positive for income (e.g. -10.5).

paid_date.description: Payment date. Setting it marks the transaction as paid.

competence_date.description: Competence date: when the service was provided or the sale made.

person_id.description: Customer id for income, supplier id for expense.

external_id.description: Id of this transaction in another system.

auto_pay.description: Mark as paid automatically on the due date.

tools.name: granatum_update_transaction
tools.title: Update a transaction
tools.description: Change fields of an existing transaction (lançamento). Send only the fields to change. Set propagate_to_installments to apply the change to later installments. Granatum API: PUT /v1/lancamentos/{id}.

propagate_to_installments.description: Apply the change to later installments too.

paid_date.description: Payment date. Setting it marks the transaction as paid.

competence_date.description: Competence date: when the service was provided or the sale made.

person_id.description: Customer id for income, supplier id for expense.

external_id.description: Id of this transaction in another system.

auto_pay.description: Mark as paid automatically on the due date.
